findings.evidence: Lines 130–140 use commutation only because the proof detours through generalized eigenspaces. Mathlib `LinearAlgebra/Eigenspace/Basic.lean:721` already gives independence of eigenspaces for one operator; in a minimal dependence among joint eigenvectors, applying any selected operator shows all participating tuples have the same value at that index, hence the tuples coincide.
findings.fix: Prove `iSupIndep fun χ ↦ ⨅ i, (f i).eigenspace (χ i)` for arbitrary `f`, using a minimal finite dependence and an index separating two tuples, then remove `hcomm` from both independence declarations and rename the first accordingly.
findings.issue: `iSupIndep_iInf_eigenspace_of_commute` assumes `hcomm`, although joint eigenvectors with distinct eigenvalue tuples are linearly independent without commutation; line 206 propagates the same unnecessary hypothesis to the character-indexed theorem.

summary: The independence API unnecessarily requires pairwise commutation; ordinary joint eigenspaces for distinct eigenvalue functions are independent for an arbitrary family.
